title: illucam - The RTSP Stream Simulator
excerpt: Instantly spin up virtual RTSP streams using your own MP4 files for testing computer vision models.

The Ultimate RTSP Stream Simulator for Developers & AI Teams

Instantly spin up virtual RTSP streams using your own MP4 files. Perfect for testing computer vision models, video analytics, and VMS integrations without physical hardware.

Start for Free

Zero Hardware Required

Upload your MP4 files and illucam generates compliant, reliable RTSP streams instantly. No more buying and configuring physical IP cameras for testing.

Chaos Mode

Test the resilience of your systems by simulating real-world network conditions. Inject packet loss, latency, and stream interruptions with one click.

Enterprise Scale

From single-camera hobby projects to massive VMS deployments with hundreds of concurrent streams, illucam scales to meet your exact testing requirements.
